entry.title: Research Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: This week's research coverage is dominated by the new Hermes-Claude subscription plugin: a deep dive into the pipeline architecture — Hermes drives the unmodified official Claude CLI over native stream-json — paired with security documentation of its auth model, which keeps credentials entirely with the official Claude Code CLI so users never hand Hermes an API key. The enabling capability ships in Hermes Agent v0.21.4 (v2026.9.21, 21 September 2026), adding a --format stream-json CLI flag that emits structured JSONL for machine-readable output; the release rollup also brings skills auto-load and MCP discovery concurrency improvements. Ecosystem round-up: AgentProto v0.20.0 (22 September 2026), a new open-source TypeScript agent runtime listing Hermes among 14 supported integrations — a notable interoperability signal — and Microsoft Agent Framework 1.19.0 (18 September 2026), whose MCP security hardening (per-invocation session scoping) and vector-store changes are adjacent reading for agent tooling trends. Practical takeaways: plugin users can run Claude with their existing subscription without exposing credentials, and v0.21.4's JSONL output unlocks scripted and programmatic Hermes Agent workflows.
